title: Gentle Nudge
user: Independent service providers who need to prepare consistent, escalating but human-approved payment reminders without delegating client relationships to an AI bot.
smallest_useful_product: Local PWA with invoice dates, editable stage templates, a due-today queue, client-specific pause notes, and copy/email-draft output.
success_measure: After 45 days, pilot users prepare a first reminder within two business days of due date for at least 80% of overdue invoices.
constraints: No automated email, profiling, or collection threats; templates should be editable and jurisdiction-neutral; local data export/delete is mandatory.
